subject.title: fix(pairing): preserve authorized senders when allowFrom reads fail

question: Should this PR be repaired into the narrow pairing fix, fully reviewed as a broad multi-surface change, or closed and recreated cleanly?
rationale: The current head combines a useful authorization-store bug fix with a large unrelated workflow/dependency/app/generated diff and an incomplete malformed-JSON fail-closed path, so the permanent merge shape requires maintainer ownership.

options.title: Repair to the narrow pairing fix
options.body: Rebuild the branch from current main with only the pairing files, make parse failures fail closed for mutation pre-reads, and reuse the EACCES proof on the exact repaired head.

options.title: Review as a broad change
options.body: Keep the current 300-file head only if maintainers intentionally want to review and prove the workflow, dependency, app, extension, docs, and generated changes together.

options.title: Close and recreate cleanly
options.body: Close this branch as dirty if preserving it is slower than opening a new narrow PR with contributor credit for the original pairing diagnosis.

recommendation.title: Repair to the narrow pairing fix
recommendation.body: Rebuild the branch from current main with only the pairing files, make parse failures fail closed for mutation pre-reads, and reuse the EACCES proof on the exact repaired head.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the live assignee and has both prior pairing-store history and secops-trusted context for the dependency/workflow surfaces now present on the branch.
